title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Technical Project Specialist
description:
ZTE is looking for The Technical Project Specialist – Data Center / IDC is a hybrid technical delivery and project execution role , responsible for supporting end-to-end delivery of Integrated Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical E&M projects , from bid support and estimation through planning, site execution, commissioning, acceptance, and handover .

This role operates in a matrix organization , with no direct people management , and acts as a technical project owner at execution level , coordinating internal teams and external contractors to ensure scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and acceptance objectives are met.


Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Support end-to-end project delivery for Data Center / IDC E&M projects , including electrical and HVAC scope.
  • Translate bid assumptions into execution plans, schedules, and acceptance criteria .
  • Coordinate site execution activities in alignment with approved scope, schedule, and quality standards.

Bid Support, Estimation & BOM

  • Support bidding and pre-sales activities with technical inputs.
  • Prepare or validate cost estimations , Bill of Materials (BOM) , and delivery assumptions.
  • Provide technical and execution inputs to protect project feasibility and margins.

Planning & Schedule Control

  • Develop and maintain baseline project schedules (e.G., MS Project, Primavera or equivalent).
  • Track progress, critical path, risks, and deviations, proposing corrective and mitigation actions.

Site Coordination (Matrix Environment)

  • Coordinate technical activities across engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, finance/contracts , and external vendors/subcontractors .
  • Ensure alignment on scope, cost, schedule, quality, safety, testing, and acceptance readiness .
  • Act as a technical focal point during execution, without direct people management.

Quality, HSE & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support and verify compliance with HSE, site safety, and quality requirements .
  • Ensure adherence to applicable Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) , including NR-10 (Electrical Safety) and NR-35 (Work at Height) , according to project scope.
  • Support audits, inspections, and closure of non-conformities.

Commissioning, Acceptance & Handover

  • Coordinate commissioning and acceptance readiness , including punch lists, test evidence, and acceptance documentation.
  • Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover packages to customers.

Cost Control & Collections Interface

  • Track execution cost drivers and efficiency.
  • Support payment milestone and collections readiness by ensuring technical and acceptance deliverables are completed in line with contractual requirements.

Process Improvement & Digital Tools

  • Support implementation and continuous improvement of IDC delivery processes, controls, and reporting .
  • Promote use of digital tools for planning, reporting, and documentation control.

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

  • Act as a technical interface with customers, internal stakeholders, and partners .
  • Support customer satisfaction through transparent communication and execution discipline.


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Center (IDC) / Mission Critical infrastructure project delivery ,
  • or equivalent experience in critical electrical or HVAC construction projects with site exposure.
  • Proven experience supporting project execution and customer acceptance in construction or mission-critical environments.
  • Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial/Production Engineering , or related fields is preferred .
  • Technical/technologist degrees may be considered with strong hands-on experience in mission-critical environments.
  • English : Advanced (mandatory ) – spoken and written.
  • Portuguese : Fluent (mandatory ).
  • Mandarin Chinese and/or Spanish: nice to have.
  • Solid knowledge of electrical systems or HVAC for data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, site documentation, and specifications .
  • Experience with AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, execution tracking, risk and issue management , and acceptance preparation.
  • Basic contract and scope awareness related to milestones, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).
  • Strong communication and coordination skills in multi-stakeholder environments.


Mobility

Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • MBA or Postgraduate degree in Project Management, Operations, or Engineering.
  • Experience in large-scale or international data center projects .
  • Familiarity with commissioning and testing of mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with MS Project, Primavera , advanced Excel, or reporting tools.
  • Exposure to documentation control , including change logs, punch lists, and handover documentation.
  • Knowledge of HSE practices in construction or critical environments.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.E. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.

title: Representante Comercial (Rca) | Hunter Região Norte
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Norte



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp,, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Electrical Bim Speiclaist
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.

We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

- Competitive hourly pay

- Fully remote work

- Learning platforms for professional growth

- Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform VDC production work including electrical BIM modeling, coordination support, shop drawings, and spool/prefabrication drawings based on project requirements.
  • Do assigned tasks and deliverables on time and accurately.
  • Ensure meeting design requirements, NEC code compliance expectations, Eracore quality standards, client requirements, and project specifications.

  • Follow Eracore modeling standards, drawing standards, and project.
  • Provide regular updates on progress, raise questions when scope or design intent is unclear, communicate issues that may impact schedule or quality.

  • Work collaboratively with team members to meet project deadlines, support coordination needs.


What We’re Looking For

- 2+ years of experience in Electrical BIM

- Experience in modeling of electrical systems

- Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus

- Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection

- Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam

- Team-oriented mindset

- Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

- Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

Samsung Electronics is seeking a Senior Manager to join its dynamic Latin America Public Relations team to support the strategy and execution for brand and product programs on behalf of Samsung Latin America. This role will be responsible for Product and Corporate campaigns, crisis management, reports and internal communications coordination in Latin American channels. The Public Relations Senior Manager will report to LATAM PR Director and will collaborate frequently with the larger PR structure, PR agencies and Samsung marketing and product teams in LATAM and in Korea.

  • Collaborate with the marketing and product teams in Latin America.
  • Manage PR agency teams to localize global communications content including press releases, briefing information, executive viewpoints, Q&As, and other relevant content.
  • Own the PR agency relationships, set goals, and ensure results are achieved.
  • Create local content to support the communications approach.
  • Be a local support for wider communications activities including social media, analyst relations and, when relevant, corporate social responsibility activities.
  • Successfully manage complex, fast-moving and unexpected communications challenges and manage issues/media inquiries related.
  • Manage issues and crises, provide strategic counsel to cross-functional stakeholders, and serve as a core member of the leadership and crisis management team for Brazil.
  • Write strategic plans, messaging and press releases.
  • Planning event, internal and external, from start to finish according to requirements, target audience and objectives.
  • Coordinate report production and governance.
  • Manage Internal Communications channel, leading production team providing strategy and direction.


Requirements

  • Experience developing/implementing and evaluating brand communications strategies.
  • Corporate communications leadership experience.
  • Excellent Written and spoken English and Portuguese language skills. Advanced Spanish is a plus.
  • Experience with digital and social media as well as influencer marketing/communication Issues management experience including development of messaging and Q&A documents.
  • Strong understanding of measuring the impacts and benefits of communications programs.
  • Experience working on creative proactive campaigns.
  • Bachelor degree.

description:
Processo seletivo afirmativo para mulheres.


Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay

Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Delegar tarefas e atribuições ao time técnico, dando todo o apoio necessário para que evoluam rapidamente na perspectiva técnica, se tornando de alta performance
  • Conduzir efetivos 1:1 com o seu time técnico
  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico (usuário, veículo, débitos, pagamentos, etc).
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Conduzir a resolução de problemas e contribuir ativamente com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Python, Node.Js, React, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhecer todas essas tecnologias, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.
  • Conduzir auditorias de segurança e estrutura em busca de oportunidades de melhorias.


Requisitos e qualificações

Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .

  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams

  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Status: Full-time/Contract

Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal

  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)

title: Especialista Em Viário (Owner’s Engineer)
description:
Estamos estruturando o time do Consórcio Gerenciador (Owner’s Engineer) para um dos mais relevantes empreendimentos de infraestrutura do país. Trata-se de um projeto portuário de grande porte, com solução de engenharia inovadora e elevada complexidade técnica, envolvendo interface com operações logísticas estratégicas e alto nível de exigência em planejamento, gestão e controle.


Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Você será a referência de Viário no ciclo completo do projeto da concepção e definição de premissas, passando por projeto executivo, até entrega da obra garantindo conformidade contratual e ARTESP, com interface contínua com EPC (projetista + construtora).

Modelo e local de trabalho:

Contratação: PJ (tempo indeterminado)

Reporte: Gerente de Engenharia (interface direta e contínua com EPC)

Regime: presencial, com home office em dias a combinar conforme programação semanal

Base inicial: São Paulo — Parque da Cidade (Av. das Nações Unidas, 14401)

Atividades presenciais em Santos ao longo de 2027 (frequência a confirmar)


Responsabilidades da posição:

Premissas e soluções viárias (do zero até a entrega)

  • Ser o ponto focal técnico de Viário para os acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, garantindo coerência entre premissas, alternativas, projeto executivo e obra.
  • Definir, revisar e validar critérios e padrões de projeto (geometria, velocidades, níveis de serviço, superelevação, seções típicas, drenagem associada e interfaces), considerando restrições urbanas e ambiente portuário.
  • Analisar e apoiar estudos de alternativas (traçados, interseções, dispositivos, acessos, retornos e conexões), incluindo avaliações comparativas de desempenho, construtibilidade, riscos e impactos.

Integrações e interfaces urbanas/operacionais

  • Garantir integração do viário com disciplinas correlatas: estruturas/OAEs, contenções, pavimentação, drenagem, sinalização/segurança viária, iluminação, utilidades/interferências, desapropriações e acessibilidade.
  • Coordenar requisitos para atendimento a condicionantes de tráfego (manutenção de circulação, planos de desvio, fases de obra, acesso a comunidades/operadores e logística do canteiro).
  • Atuar na compatibilização com operação de sistemas associados quando aplicável (fluxos, restrições, acessos operacionais/emergência e áreas técnicas).

Pavimentação e reabilitação viária

  • Revisar e validar soluções de pavimentação (dimensionamento, materiais, camadas, controles tecnológicos, vida útil e estratégias de manutenção), incluindo intervenções em vias existentes, reforços e recomposições.
  • Validar critérios de desempenho e durabilidade compatíveis com tráfego previsto, ambiente e restrições de execução.

Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

  • Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes de desenhos, memoriais, especificações, quantitativos, critérios de aceitação e planos de inspeção/ensaio, garantindo rastreabilidade de decisões e atendimento aos ritos de aprovação.
  • Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista e o CQP/certificação, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de projeto, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 5 anos) em projetos viários urbanos e/ou rodoviários, com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica (geometria, dispositivos, acessos e interseções)
  • Vivência com obras complexas e interfaces multidisciplinares (EPC, projetista, construtora, certificação/qualidade).
  • Capacidade de conduzir análises técnicas e propor soluções considerando segurança viária, construtibilidade, impactos urbanos e faseamento de obra.
  • Capacidade de revisão crítica de projetos e comunicação clara entre times de projeto, obra e stakeholders.
  • Inglês intermediário obrigatório;
    fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com planejamento e gestão de tráfego em obra (desvios, fases, manutenção de circulação e comunicação com partes interessadas).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de governança técnica, auditoria, rastreabilidade e gestão de interfaces.


O que você ganha trabalhando aqui

Participação em um projeto de grande impacto regional e nacional, com solução de engenharia túnel imerso, pioneiro na América Latina.

Experiência única, com atuação no viário dos acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, em um ambiente portuário de alta complexidade, com participantes internacionais, em um time com tomada de decisão de alto nível.


Processo e remuneração

Valores serão compartilhados com candidatos que avançarem para a próxima etapa.

Na fase seguinte, solicitaremos uma apresentação aos selecionados.

Como se candidatar

Envie CV destacando pontos aderência aos requisitos da vaga.

description:

A EPR é uma plataforma de investimentos em concessões de rodovias e mobilidade. Nosso propósito é prestação de serviços de excelência aos usuários, administração e realização de investimentos consistentes para modernização e manutenção das rodovias concedidas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento sustentável das regiões que atuamos.


Missão do Cargo

Responsável por gerenciar, sustentar e monitorar ativos e serviços críticos de tecnologia. O profissional garantirá a disponibilidade dos recursos de TI para a sede administrativa, praças de pedágio, bases operacionais e sistemas de pesagem. Atuará como líder técnico , fornecendo suporte Nível 3, apoiando os analistas Juniores (N1/N2) e sendo o ponto focal para incidentes de alta complexidade (NOC/SOC).


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Suporte e Liderança: Suporte técnico Nível 3 e mentoria técnica para as equipes de Níveis 1 e 2.
  • Projetos e Implementação: Apoio técnico na execução de projetos desenhados pelos Arquitetos de Infraestrutura e Cybersegurança.
  • Gestão de Ativos Críticos: Configuração e gerenciamento de Servidores, Storages, Switches, Firewalls e Access Points (APs).
  • Cloud Computing: Implantação e parametrização de serviços em nuvem (Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, redes virtuais e segurança em Cloud).
  • Virtualização: Instalação e implementação de máquinas virtuais e hosts (VMware e Hyper-V).
  • Segurança e Incidentes: Ponto focal em troubleshooting de incidentes de serviços e ativos de segurança detectados pelo NOC/SOC.
  • Continuidade de Negócio: Gestão estratégica de rotinas de Backup, Restore e planos de Disaster Recovery (DR).
  • Telecom e Conectividade: Monitoramento de links de dados/voz e suporte especializado a redes cabeadas e Wi-Fi.
  • Sistemas Operacionais: Implantação e manutenção de sistemas VMS e CFTV.
  • Gestão de Parceiros: Interface técnica com fornecedores (Dell, Microsoft, Brasoftware, ThinkIT, etc.) para implantações e suporte.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 5 anos de atuação comprovada como Analista de Redes/Infraestrutura.
  • Competências Técnicas:
  • Sólido conhecimento em administração de servidores e storages.
  • Domínio em ferramentas de virtualização (VMware/Hyper-V).
  • Experiência com ativos de rede e segurança (Firewall, Switch).
  • Familiaridade com ambiente Azure (Virtual Machines e Redes Virtuais).
  • Mobilidade: CNH categoria B válida e prática em dirigir (essencial para trânsito entre unidades).
  • Habilidades: Proatividade, organização impecável, comunicação fluida e alto senso de urgência.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação em TI ou Segurança da Informação.
  • Certificações: AZ-900 , AZ-500 , ITIL ou COBIT .
  • Experiência no segmento de concessão de rodovias ou infraestruturas críticas.


Benefícios

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer

IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>
>
IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>
>
IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>

>
CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>
>

>
>

operational considerations).

>

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment

Preferred Experience

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

Experience: 1 to 7 years in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Venture Capital

*Please apply through the Google form link at the bottom of this page.


Our Platform

We're a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. Our structure organizes investments into focused portfolios that function as specialized operating groups, each developing deep domain expertise, proven operational playbooks and long-term partnerships with founders and management teams.


We combine operational rigor with a growth equity mindset - partnering closely with leadership teams to drive sustainable ARR growth, profitability improvements and industry-leading customer outcomes.

Our current investment portfolios include:

  • Emergence Mobility Technologies (AutoTech) – Next-generation vehicle acquisition and inventory management platforms
  • Emergence Healthcare Technologies (HCIT) – High-efficiency billing optimization, patient engagement, and clinical care software
  • Emergence Container Technologies (Cloud Infrastructure) – Modern DevOps, observability, and secure cloud performance tools
  • Emergence Procurement Technologies (Supply Chain Tech) – Procurement, logistics, and manufacturing visibility systems


The Role

Strategic Finance & Investments – Analyst

  • Finance at Emergence is not “reporting after the fact.” It is how we make decisions. The bar is high because the work gets used in real rooms with real stakes.
  • This is a hybrid role that sits between investing and strategic finance. You will help build the financial engine across more than 10+ growing portfolio companies in different sectors, including Auto, Healthcare, and Infrastructure Software.
  • It is a great seat for someone early in their career who wants real reps, fast feedback, and a lot of ownership. You will learn quickly because you will have to. You will also get exposed to the CEO and CFO level across U.S. software businesses in addition to the management team at Emergence.


What You Will Spend Your Time Doing

You will do a mix of hands-on building and higher-level thinking, including:

  • Building and maintaining detailed operating models used to forecast performance and guide decisions (revenue, retention, pricing, hiring plans, cash, and scenarios)
  • Standing up “finance infrastructure” that actually works across portfolio companies, including reporting packages, KPI dashboards, budget versus actuals, and forecasting cadences
  • Supporting investor and capital raise work, including preparing materials, cleaning up data rooms, and tightening the metrics story so it holds up under scrutiny
  • Working closely with accounting leaders to improve the quality of the numbers (close hygiene, chart of accounts structure, consistency of definitions, and data integrity)
  • Contributing to new M&A theses and diligence, including market research, unit economics work, and translating messy diligence inputs into clear decision memos


What Makes Someone Successful Here

This is not a role where you can hide behind “good effort.” The models either tie out or they do not.

People who do well here tend to:

  • Take pride in accuracy and consistency, even on the unglamorous stuff
  • Catch issues early and fix them without needing a lot of airtime
  • Ask sharp questions and then go do the work to answer them
  • Communicate clearly in English, both in writing and live, because you will work with U.S.-based executives and investors
  • Stay calm when priorities shift, and still deliver something clean


Requirements

  • 1 to 7 years of IB, PE, or VC experience (or an extremely close equivalent)
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including building models from scratch and stress-testing assumptions
  • Solid accounting and finance fundamentals (you do not need to be a CPA, but you do need to know what you are looking at)
  • Ability to overlap meaningfully with U.S. working hours

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director) - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain "Brilliance or Nothing" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and "breaking" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the "click" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the "Stream Team" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and "elite" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and "breaking" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted "fellow degen" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

- Excellent communication and organizational skills

What We Offer:

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Stripe & Fintech Specialist)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Stripe Connect to lead the evolution of a critical payment infrastructure.

This role will be responsible for architecting and implementing a robust Stripe Connect integration within a core Django API, supporting the migration from a legacy Ruby on Rails payment portal.

You will lead the end-to-end payment lifecycle - from onboarding and funds flow to webhook orchestration and complex business logic - ensuring scalability, security, and reliability across payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement Stripe Connect integrations (Standard, Express, or Custom) within a Django/Python environment
  • Design and build complex payment flows (split payments, payouts, fee collection)
  • Develop resilient, idempotent webhook processing systems for real-time Stripe events
  • Lead migration of payment logic and data from a legacy Ruby on Rails application into a Django-based architecture
  • Integrate Stripe events with core backend workflows and business processes
  • Implement asynchronous processing using Celery and Redis for high-volume payment tasks
  • Ensure adherence to PCI-DSS standards and best practices for financial data security
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and logging for payment flows (Datadog, Sentry, or similar tools)
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, maintaining high test coverage


Technical Stack

Backend: Python 3.11+, Django 4.X, Django REST Framework (DRF)

Payments: Stripe (Connect, Billing, Webhooks)

Task Queue: Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ)

Database: PostgreSQL (Aurora Serverless v2)

Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, ElastiCache)


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building production-grade payment systems
  • Deep understanding of Stripe Connect and marketplace payment architectures
  • Experience migrating legacy systems to modern backend frameworks
  • Solid knowledge of asynchronous architectures and event-driven systems
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead complex backend initiatives

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time;
    make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (Zos) - Home Office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps;
    deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

description:
Sobre a empresa

Construtora líder no segmento popular e com atuação destacada no Médio/Alto Padrão no RS. Hoje com 6 canteiros ativos e plano de expansão para 10 canteiros até 2028. A empresa é referência no uso de soluções de engenharia e conta com time forte em planejamento, projetos e gestão de obras.

Importante: a posição não é na Alfaiate Consultoria em Estratégia.



Missão do cargo

Garantir excelência na entrega da experiência do cliente nos decorados, clubes e plantões (qualidade, manutenção, segurança, padrão visual e funcionamento), assegurando padronização de rotinas , prontidão dos espaços , agilidade na resolução de demandas e integração fluida com Obra, Assistência Técnica, Suprimentos e Comercial .



Principais responsabilidades

1) Operação de decorados / clubes / plantões

  • Organizar e conduzir a rotina de funcionamento dos espaços (abertura, checklists, inspeções, manutenção preventiva e corretiva).
  • Garantir padrão de apresentação: acabamentos aparentes, limpeza técnica, iluminação, marcenaria, mobiliário, sinalização e itens de ambientação.
  • Atuar como dono do espaço: identificar riscos/defeitos e resolver antes de virar reclamação.

2) Qualidade percebida e correção rápida de problemas

  • Mapear e tratar falhas recorrentes (acabamento, infiltrações, portas/esquadrias, elétrica/iluminação, ar, hidráulica, pintura, rejunte etc.).
  • Acionar e coordenar empreiteiros/fornecedores para correções com prazo curto e padrão alto.
  • Registrar ocorrências, causa raiz e lições aprendidas para reduzir reincidência.

3) Interface com Obra e Assistência Técnica (AT)

  • Integrar demandas do decorado/clube com engenheiros de obra e AT (priorização, agendamento, evidências e aceite).
  • Antecipar dores de entrega: usar feedback do decorado/plantão para retroalimentar obra (padrões, detalhes executivos, acabamentos).
  • Apoiar preparação de entrega quando necessário (vistorias, ajustes finais, punch list).

4) Gestão de fornecedores e contratos de manutenção

  • Coordenar terceiros (marcenaria, mobiliário, climatização, elétrica, pintura, limpeza, paisagismo, automação, audiovisual, internet).
  • Controlar qualidade, escopo, prazos e custo de chamados e manutenções.
  • Apoiar compras/reposições e controle de ativos do decorado (itens, peças, garantias).

5) Segurança e conformidade dos espaços

  • Garantir condições seguras para equipe e visitantes: rotas, sinalização, extintores, riscos elétricos, acessos, ergonomia e boas práticas.
  • Zelar por procedimentos e registros básicos (checklists, ocorrências, liberações de serviço, evidências).

6) Rotina de reporte e gestão por indicadores

  • Consolidar status semanal por empreendimento, sobre pendências, riscos, chamados abertos, prazos e prioridades.
  • Conduzir alinhamentos rápidos com interfaces (Comercial, Engenharia, AT, Suprimentos).



Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil (concluída) e CREA ativo (ou encaminhado/regular).
  • Vivência em obra, pós-obra, acabamentos, manutenção ou assistência técnica (mesmo que inicial), com atenção a detalhe e padrão.
  • Capacidade de coordenar terceiros e liderar as obras com rapidez (cobrança, agenda, prioridade).
  • Organização e disciplina para checklists, registro de chamados e acompanhamento de pendências.
  • Domínio funcional de Excel (controle simples) e boa comunicação no dia a dia com múltiplas áreas.
  • Residir em Porto Alegre/RS ou Região Metropolitana (eliminatório).
  • CNH B e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e rotinas presenciais;
    eventualmente sábados.



Diferenciais

  • Experiência com acabamentos , entrega, assistência técnica, manutenção predial ou operação de espaços (decorado/plantão).
  • Vivência com Sienge (ou ERP similar), controles de chamados, fornecedores e contratos.
  • Perfil "Mão na massa” com postura de dono e senso estético/qualidade percebida.



Perfil comportamental

  • Capricho técnico + senso de padrão (enxerga detalhe e não aceita entregas com defeito).
  • Agilidade e autonomia (resolve, cobra, destrava).
  • Organização e rotina (checklists, pendências, prioridades, evidências).
  • Boa articulação com obra, AT, suprimentos e comercial.
  • Postura de dono do espaço e foco em experiência do cliente.



Remuneração e modelo

  • Possibilidade de evolução para posições de maior responsabilidade (ex.: engenheiro residente), conforme performance.

  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados.
  • Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados.
  • Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada.

  • Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java).


  • Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável.


  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas.


  • Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

title: Professor De Francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

É estrategista financeiro do cliente.

O que fazemos de verdade

- Planejamento patrimonial completo

- Wealth management

- Riscos, sucessão e proteção

- Crédito estruturado e imobiliário

Buscamos Assessores de Investimentos experientes, que:

- Já atendem clientes PF e/ou PJ

- Entendem que planejamento gera mais valor (e mais receita) do que giro de produto

- Querem construir carreira e patrimônio, não apenas comissão do mês

- Valorizam ambiente meritocrático, colaborativo e sem pressão comercial artificial


Ter carteira ativa é um diferencial relevante.


⸻


O que você NÃO vai encontrar aqui

- Meta de produto

- Ranking forçado

- Pressão para empurrar o que não faz sentido

- Estrutura frágil ou discurso vazio


⸻


O que você VAI encontrar

- Modelo validado e replicável

- Apoio técnico real

- Liberdade para fazer o certo para o cliente

- Remuneração consistente e acima da média no longo prazo

- Um ambiente onde bons assessores crescem e permanecem



Se você procura um escritório para “se esconder na marca”, essa vaga não é para você.


Se você quer construir autoridade, relacionamento e patrimônio junto com seus clientes, converse conosco.

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for over 115 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken);
    Portuguese required;
    Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.
  • Strong ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Skilled in relationship building across organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with scientific information tools and intellectual property solutions (preferred).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil;
with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.

title: Sr Frontend Developer (React Native Y Vue.Js)
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
